meta.derivation: Syllable grid romanizations read as-is from glyphs-handfill.json. Col 0 rows U+F040..U+F4E0 (stride 0x20); cols 1..25 follow header finals U+F021..U+F039. Components from glyphs with role initial/final (U+F500..F545), groups merged from chart-tables-handfill.md.
